segments.sn35.81:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn35.81:1.2: “idha no, bhante, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā amhe evaṃ pucchanti –
segments.sn35.81:1.4: Evaṃ puṭṭhā mayaṃ, bhante, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākaroma –
segments.sn35.81:1.5: ‘dukkhassa kho, āvuso, pariññatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti.
segments.sn35.81:1.6: Kacci mayaṃ, bhante, evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino ceva bhagavato homa, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāma, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaroma, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī”ti?
segments.sn35.81:2.1: “Taggha tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino ceva me hotha, na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhatha, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarotha, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
segments.sn35.81:2.2: Dukkhassa hi, bhikkhave, pariññatthaṃ mayi brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
segments.sn35.81:2.3: Sace pana vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn35.81:2.4: ‘katamaṃ pana taṃ, āvuso, dukkhaṃ, yassa pariññāya samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti?
segments.sn35.81:2.5: Evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha –
segments.sn35.81:2.6: ‘cakkhu kho, āvuso, dukkhaṃ, tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
segments.sn35.81:2.8: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn35.81:2.9: Tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati … pe …
segments.sn35.81:2.11: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn35.81:2.13: Idaṃ kho taṃ, āvuso, dukkhaṃ, tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti.
segments.sn35.81:2.14: Evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyāthā”ti.
